body:
What this app needs is the option of setting an alarm. I’ve missed so many reminders because I did not have an alarm draw my attention to the event.

It works well if I set an alarm as well, but the alarm app has limited functionality too and you can’t selectively set it for a specific future event without making it recurring.

I would take the two apps, combine them as they did with Find My, and make it possible to set alarms for future reminders.
